title: Features
introduction: Discover the features that make AgriFlow the ideal solution for managing your agricultural operations.
subtitle: Our key features

crop_management.title: Crop Management
crop_management.description: Track the evolution of your crops from planting to harvest with a customizable status system.
crop_management.full_description: Our crop management module allows you to follow each stage of your crops' lifecycle. Define custom statuses, record observations, and measure yields to optimize your agricultural practices.

how_it_works.title: How it works
how_it_works.description: Create a crop, define its location, type, and variety. Track its evolution through different statuses (seeding, growth, harvest, etc.). Record interventions and important observations. Analyze performance to improve your practices.

testimonial.title: What our users say
testimonial.quote: Thanks to AgriFlow's crop management module, I was able to improve my plot yields by 15% by identifying problems more quickly and optimizing my interventions.
testimonial.author: John Smith, Farmer

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.description: Manage your stocks of inputs, equipment, and products to optimize your resources.

reporting.title: Reports and Analysis
reporting.description: Generate detailed reports on your activities to make better decisions.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Plan your agricultural interventions with an interactive calendar and reminders.
